title.en: present perfect with for and since

explain.ko: 현재완료와 함께 for는 '기간'(five years, two weeks), since는 '시작 시점'(2020, January, I was a child)을 나타냅니다. 'How long have you ...?'로 기간을 묻습니다. 현재까지 이어지는 상태에는 have been, have lived, have known처럼 씁니다.
explain.en: With the present perfect, for is followed by a period of time (five years, two weeks) and since by a starting point (2020, January, I was a child). Ask 'How long have you ...?' for a situation that continues until now.

head: 표현 / Pattern
예 / Example
rows: I have lived here for five years.
How long have you lived here?
I haven't seen her for a week.

notes.ko: for + 기간 (for two years), since + 시작 시점 (since 2020).
notes.en: for + length of time; since + starting point.

notes.ko: 지금까지 이어지는 상태에는 현재완료: I have known him for ten years.
notes.en: Use the present perfect for situations that continue until now.

notes.ko: 지금 끝난 일에는 과거형: I lived there for five years.
notes.en: For finished situations use the past simple: I lived there for five years.
